all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3])
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 1]) == False
  let n = xs.len()
  for i in range(0, n)
    for j in range(i + 1, n)
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  pre n <= 1000000
  pre seed >= 0
  pre seed <= 1000000000
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 5).len() == 0
  ex make_ids(3, 7).len() == 3
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  var ids: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    ids.append(seed + i)
  ids
